nodes.description: Owner-only function that transfers the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that mints 48 reserved tokens to the owner in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
Owner-only setter for the provenance hash string.
Owner-only setter that updates the ERC721 base URI.
Owner-only toggle for the saleIsActive boolean.
Payable public mint function enforcing sale state, per-tx cap, supply cap and price.
Returns the token metadata URI after shifting tokenId by startingIndex modulo MAX_BANANAX.
Derives the reveal starting index from blockhash of startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Public string holding the provenance hash of the collection.
Public block number used as source of randomness for the reveal index.
Public reveal offset applied to token IDs in tokenURI.
Constant mint price of 0.06 ETH per token.
Constant maximum number of tokens purchasable per transaction (20).
Public maximum supply of tokens, set at construction.
Public boolean gate controlling whether minting is enabled.
Public timestamp after which the reveal can be triggered.
External caller address, controls callers of mint/withdraw/reserve and receives tokens and ETH.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
msg.sender.transfer(balance) low-level ETH transfer inside withdraw.
Repeated _safeMint call inside the reserve loop triggering receiver callbacks.
_safeMint call inside mintBananax loop invoking IERC721Receiver on the buyer.
jbxPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) arithmetic check of the payment amount.
totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) arithmetic supply-cap check.
uint(blockhash(startingIndexBlock)) % MAX_BANANAX weak randomness source.
Comparison block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP controlling reveal trigger.
startingIndex.add(1) adjustment preventing a default zero index.
Caller-supplied quantity of tokens requested in mintBananax.
New reveal timestamp passed to setRevealTimestamp.
Provenance hash string passed to setProvenanceHash.
Base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
Token identifier passed to tokenURI for metadata resolution.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the contract balance via transfer in withdraw, an external value transfer to an untrusted party.
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint inside the reserveBananax loop, enabling receiver callbacks.
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint inside mintBananax, enabling receiver callbacks.
block.timestamp flows into the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP comparison, a miner-influenced timestamp dependency.
jbxPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens in the payment arithmetic check.
Caller-supplied numberOfTokens is the multiplicand in jbxPrice.mul(numberOfTokens).
Caller-supplied numberOfTokens is added to totalSupply for the supply-cap check.
startingIndexBlock feeds blockhash, a predictable on-chain randomness dependency.
MAX_BANANAX is the modulus applied to the derived starting index.
MAX_BANANAX is used as the modulus when shifting tokenId in tokenURI.
startingIndex is added to tokenId as the reveal offset in tokenURI.
startingIndex is incremented via .add(1) to avoid a zero default index.
saleIsActive gates whether mintBananax can proceed.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is compared against the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
numberOfTokens controls the number of mint iterations and price computation.
withdraw executes the msg.sender.transfer(balance) external call.
reserveBananax loops calling _safeMint on the owner address.
mintBananax loops calling _safeMint for each requested token.
setStartingIndex computes the reveal index from blockhash of startingIndexBlock.
setStartingIndex adjusts a zero startingIndex by adding one.
mintBananax evaluates the block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP condition to set the index block.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner modifier to call withdraw.
onERC721Received callback on the buyer contract can re-enter mintBananax before state finalization.
onERC721Received callback during reserveBananax can re-enter the reserve minting flow.

Parameter is forwarded to the base URI setter inside setBaseURI.
Parameter is only used to compute the metadata URI inside tokenURI.
Local caches address(this).balance consumed by the withdraw transfer operation.
Local caches totalSupply() used as the base index for the reserve _safeMint loop.
Local caches the next token index passed to _safeMint in mintBananax.
